_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Purpur egg (pelican-eggs' Spigot egg was only read for reference). Spigot has no downloads, so the install builds it with SpigotMC's BuildTools: BuildTools build 201 pinned with the SHA-256 Octail downloaded on 2026-10-12 (SpigotMC publishes no checksum for it; staff can set another build and hash, or latest without a hash check), the build file for the Minecraft version from hub.spigotmc.org/versions (sources pinned by commit, the oldest BuildTools and the Java range), the install in octail-yolks installer_java_25 (Java 25 builds Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer, so current versions download no JDK) and a Temurin JDK with the Adoptium SHA-256 only when Java 25 is outside that range, and BuildTools' own checks of the Mojang jar and Maven. The built jar can't be compared with anything published; it must be a Spigot server. the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 to 8 images (newest first), Minecraft Java idle sleep, a longer install time limit and 3 GB of install memory, resource hints.
name: Spigot
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Spigot is the original high-performance fork of CraftBukkit and runs Bukkit and Spigot plugins. It is built from source with SpigotMC's BuildTools at install, which takes several minutes.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Spigot installation (Octail): Spigot can't be downloaded, it is built from source with SpigotMC's
# BuildTools (https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/buildtools/), which is what this script runs.
#
# What is checked:
# - BuildTools.jar comes from SpigotMC's Jenkins over HTTPS, the build must be marked SUCCESS and the
#   file must be BuildTools. SpigotMC publishes no checksum or signature for it (the MD5 fingerprint
#   Jenkins lists belongs to the Maven-deployed jar, which differs), so the egg pins a build and its
#   SHA-256 as Octail downloaded it (staff-only variables). "latest" skips the SHA-256 check.
# - The Minecraft version's build file (hub.spigotmc.org/versions/<version>.json) pins the Bukkit,
#   CraftBukkit, Spigot and BuildData sources by git commit, names the oldest BuildTools build that can
#   build it (refused here when the pinned build is older) and the Java versions it builds with.
# - BuildTools itself checks the Mojang server jar and the Maven it downloads against the hashes in
#   BuildData. The Maven dependencies of the build are fetched by Maven, which this script doesn't check.
# - A JDK that fits the version is used: the image's Java 25 (Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer,
#   26.x), or for older versions Eclipse Temurin from the Adoptium API, checked against the SHA-256
#   the API lists.
# - The built jar is not published anywhere, so there is nothing to compare it with: it must contain
#   CraftBukkit's Main class.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

VERSIONS=https://hub.spigotmc.org/versions
JOB=https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools
ADOPTIUM=https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BT_BUILD="${BUILDTOOLS_BUILD:-latest}"
BT_SHA256="$(echo "${BUILDTOOLS_SHA256:-}" | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')"
WORK=/mnt/server/.octail-buildtools

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }
fetch() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "$2" "$1"; }
cleanup() { rm -rf "${WORK}"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

[ -n "${VERSION}" ] || VERSION=latest
[[ "${VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z.-]*$ ]] || fail "the Minecraft version (${VERSION}) isn't a version name"
[[ "${JAR}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.jar$ ]] || fail "the jar name (${JAR}) must be a plain .jar file name"

# The version's build file: which sources, which BuildTools, which Java.
INFO=$(get "${VERSIONS}/${VERSION}.json") ||
	fail "Spigot has no build for Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are listed at ${VERSIONS}/"
SPIGOT_BUILD=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.name // empty')
[ -n "${SPIGOT_BUILD}" ] || fail "Spigot's build file for ${VERSION} names no build"
for repo in BuildData Bukkit CraftBukkit Spigot; do
	echo "${INFO}" | jq -e --arg r "${repo}" '.refs[$r] | test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")' >/dev/null ||
		fail "Spigot's build file for ${VERSION} doesn't pin ${repo} to a commit"
done
TOOLS_NEEDED=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.toolsVersion // 0')
# Class file versions (52 = Java 8, 65 = Java 21, 69 = Java 25); none given means Java 7 to 8.
JAVA_MIN=$(($(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.javaVersions[0] // 51') - 44))
JAVA_MAX=$(($(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.javaVersions[1] // 52') - 44))
echo "Minecraft ${VERSION}: Spigot build ${SPIGOT_BUILD}, Java ${JAVA_MIN} to ${JAVA_MAX}, BuildTools ${TOOLS_NEEDED} or newer"

# BuildTools: a pinned build (and SHA-256) or the last successful one.
if [ -z "${BT_BUILD}" ] || [ "${BT_BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BT_BUILD=lastSuccessfulBuild
	BT_SHA256=""
elif ! [[ "${BT_BUILD}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
	fail "the BuildTools build (${BT_BUILD}) must be a number or latest"
fi
[ -z "${BT_SHA256}" ] || [[ "${BT_SHA256}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || fail "the BuildTools SHA-256 must be 64 hex digits"
BT_INFO=$(get "${JOB}/${BT_BUILD}/api/json?tree=number,result,artifacts%5BrelativePath%5D") ||
	fail "SpigotMC's Jenkins has no BuildTools build ${BT_BUILD}"
BT_NUMBER=$(echo "${BT_INFO}" | jq -r '.number // empty')
[ -n "${BT_NUMBER}" ] || fail "SpigotMC's Jenkins named no BuildTools build number"
[ "$(echo "${BT_INFO}" | jq -r '.result // empty')" = "SUCCESS" ] || fail "BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER} did not succeed"
echo "${BT_INFO}" | jq -e '.artifacts | any(.relativePath == "target/BuildTools.jar")' >/dev/null ||
	fail "BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER} has no BuildTools.jar"
if [ "${BT_NUMBER}" -lt "${TOOLS_NEEDED}" ]; then
	fail "Minecraft ${VERSION} needs BuildTools build ${TOOLS_NEEDED} or newer, the egg pins ${BT_NUMBER}. Staff: set BuildTools Build to a newer build (and its SHA-256) or to latest."
fi

rm -rf "${WORK}"
mkdir -p "${WORK}"
echo "Downloading BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER}"
fetch "${JOB}/${BT_NUMBER}/artifact/target/BuildTools.jar" "${WORK}/BuildTools.jar" ||
	fail "the download of BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${WORK}/BuildTools.jar" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ -n "${BT_SHA256}" ]; then
	[ "${GOT}" = "${BT_SHA256}" ] || fail "SHA-256 mismatch for BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER} (expected ${BT_SHA256}, got ${GOT})"
	echo "BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER}: SHA-256 ${GOT} checked"
else
	echo "BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER}: SHA-256 ${GOT} (not pinned, so not checked)"
fi
unzip -l "${WORK}/BuildTools.jar" 2>/dev/null | grep -F 'org/spigotmc/builder/Bootstrap.class' >/dev/null ||
	fail "the download of BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER} isn't BuildTools"

# A JDK that fits: the image's own Java when it does, else Eclipse Temurin (newest LTS in the range).
JAVA=java
HAVE=$(java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | awk -F' = ' '/java.specification.version/ {print $2}')
HAVE=${HAVE#1.}
if [ -z "${HAVE}" ] || [ "${HAVE}" -lt "${JAVA_MIN}" ] || [ "${HAVE}" -gt "${JAVA_MAX}" ]; then
	FEATURE=""
	for lts in 25 21 17 11 8; do
		if [ "${lts}" -ge "${JAVA_MIN}" ] && [ "${lts}" -le "${JAVA_MAX}" ]; then
			FEATURE=${lts}
			break
		fi
	done
	[ -n "${FEATURE}" ] || FEATURE=${JAVA_MAX}
	case "$(uname -m)" in
	x86_64) ARCH=x64 ;;
	aarch64 | arm64) ARCH=aarch64 ;;
	*) fail "no Temurin JDK for $(uname -m)" ;;
	esac
	echo "Minecraft ${VERSION} builds with Java ${JAVA_MIN} to ${JAVA_MAX}; downloading Eclipse Temurin ${FEATURE}"
	PKG=$(get "${ADOPTIUM}/${FEATURE}/hotspot?architecture=${ARCH}&image_type=jdk&os=linux&vendor=eclipse" |
		jq -c '.[0].binary.package // empty') || fail "can't reach the Adoptium API"
	LINK=$(echo "${PKG}" | jq -r '.link // empty')
	SUM=$(echo "${PKG}" | jq -r '.checksum // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
	[[ "${LINK}" =~ ^https:// ]] || fail "the Adoptium API named no JDK ${FEATURE} download"
	[[ "${SUM}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || fail "the Adoptium API gave no SHA-256 for JDK ${FEATURE}"
	fetch "${LINK}" "${WORK}/jdk.tar.gz" || fail "the download of JDK ${FEATURE} failed"
	GOT=$(sha256sum "${WORK}/jdk.tar.gz" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
	[ "${GOT}" = "${SUM}" ] || fail "SHA-256 mismatch for JDK ${FEATURE} (expected ${SUM}, got ${GOT})"
	mkdir -p "${WORK}/jdk"
	tar -xzf "${WORK}/jdk.tar.gz" -C "${WORK}/jdk" --strip-components=1
	rm -f "${WORK}/jdk.tar.gz"
	JAVA="${WORK}/jdk/bin/java"
	[ -x "${JAVA}" ] || fail "the JDK ${FEATURE} download has no bin/java"
fi
"${JAVA}" -version 2>&1 | head -n 1

# Build. BuildTools works in its own folder (sources, Maven, the vanilla jar), removed afterwards.
echo "Building Spigot for Minecraft ${VERSION} with BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER}. This takes several minutes."
mkdir -p "${WORK}/out"
(
	cd "${WORK}"
	"${JAVA}" -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=50.0 -jar BuildTools.jar --rev "${VERSION}" --compile spigot --nogui \
		--output-dir "${WORK}/out" --final-name spigot.jar
) || fail "BuildTools could not build Spigot for Minecraft ${VERSION} (see its output above)"
[ -s "${WORK}/out/spigot.jar" ] || fail "BuildTools finished without a Spigot jar"
# 1.18 and newer build a bundler jar (org/bukkit/craftbukkit/bootstrap/Main), older ones the server itself.
unzip -l "${WORK}/out/spigot.jar" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'org/bukkit/craftbukkit/(bootstrap/)?Main\.class' >/dev/null ||
	fail "the jar BuildTools built isn't a Spigot server"
mv -f "${WORK}/out/spigot.jar" "${JAR}.download"
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "Spigot ${VERSION} (Spigot build ${SPIGOT_BUILD}) built with BuildTools build ${BT_NUMBER} and installed as ${JAR}."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to build, such as 1.21.11, or latest for the newest one Spigot builds. A version Spigot has no build file for fails the install. Every install (and reinstall) builds Spigot from source, which takes several minutes.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 25 for the newest releases, Java 21 for 1.20.5 to 1.21.x, Java 17 for 1.17 to 1.20.4, Java 8 or 11 before that.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: BuildTools Build
variables.description: The BuildTools build from hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools that builds Spigot, or latest for the last successful one. A Minecraft version that needs a newer BuildTools fails the install with the build it needs.

variables.name: BuildTools SHA-256
variables.description: The SHA-256 the BuildTools download must have (SpigotMC publishes none, so this is the hash of a download you checked yourself). Empty: not checked. Ignored when the build is latest.
